title: Fetch live BTC data and create RSI momentum strategy
objective: Verify Binance fetcher works by fetching live BTCUSDT data, then create a new RSI-based momentum strategy for the baseline library and run WFA analysis on the fetched data.
hypothesis: The Binance fetcher will successfully retrieve OHLCV data, and an RSI momentum strategy will produce different signal patterns than SMA crossover, potentially capturing crypto-specific volatility patterns.
dataset_requirements: Live BTCUSDT 1h OHLCV data from Binance (1000 candles)
implementation_steps: Run Binance fetcher to get BTCUSDT 1h data and save to workspace/data/binance_btcusdt_1h_$(date +%Y%m%d).csv
Create new RSI momentum strategy at workspace/strategies/rsi_momentum.py
Run WFA analysis with RSI strategy on the fetched BTC data

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: Binance data fetched successfully (CSV exists with >500 rows), RSI strategy created, WFA report generated with valid metrics

fallback_if_blocked: Verify CSV has correct OHLCV format
Check WFA engine parameter handling for RSI strategy
notes: This tests the crypto data pipeline end-to-end
RSI strategy uses 14-period RSI with overbought/oversold thresholds (70/30)
Different from SMA crossover - tests momentum vs trend-following
